description: TRASPORTO PUBBLICO URBANO ANNO 2011 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Palermo. la tabella contiene i dati relativi al trasporto pubblico urbano "ferrovia" anno 2011 elencando le specifiche quali lunghezza della rete in servizio e il numero di stazioni del servizio metropolitano e li raffronta con i dati del 2010. Coverage: Comune di Palermo. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Palermo. Its tags are ferrovia, trasporto. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-11-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
